description: This file contains implementations of scatter and gather operations optimized for Apple MPS backend, including functions for gathering, scattering with various reduction modes, and related utilities within the PyTorch framework.

classes.name: CachedGraph
classes.description: A cache structure for MPS graph objects used in gather and scatter operations.

methods.name: gather_out_mps
methods.description: Performs a gather operation on tensors using MPS, with support for slicing and shape adjustments.

methods.name: scatter_mps_general
methods.description: Generalized scatter function supporting multiple reduction modes, optimized for MPS.

methods.name: scatter_src_out_mps
methods.description: Scatter with source tensor output, using the 'set' reduction mode.

methods.name: scatter_value_out_mps
methods.description: Scatter with a scalar value, filling the source tensor before scattering.

methods.name: scatter_reduce_out_mps
methods.description: Scatter with specified reduction mode, outputting to a tensor.

methods.name: scatter_value_reduce_out_mps
methods.description: Scatter with scalar value and reduction mode, outputting to a tensor.

methods.name: scatter_reduce_two_mps_kernel
methods.description: Kernel dispatch for scatter with reduction, supporting mean, sum, product, min, max.
